decisions.reason: As a prominently presented extension of the firm's traditional candle-arch craft, it fits the core assortment and is worth keeping while market response becomes clearer.
This product sits very close to the firm's established Christmas-pyramid business, so its downside appears limited and there is little reason to abandon it quickly.
Because the firm presents this electronic music box as a flagship direction, management would likely preserve the option and continue learning rather than exit after only one season.
Although it has lower visibility than the main products, it is a complementary accessory to the flagship music-box line and is inexpensive to keep available while that line is tested.
This seasonal accessory is more niche and therefore somewhat more droppable, but as a low-commitment complement to the music-box concept it still merits staying on the market for now.
A themed Christmas pyramid matches the firm's traditional strengths and homepage emphasis, so management would likely retain it unless later sales clearly disappoint.
